metadata.title: Country Band Desert Landscape Layout
useCases: Band group portraits in outdoor settings

retrievalProfile.description: A multi-layered group portrait of men in western attire set against a vast desert horizon with high-contrast, wide-tracked display typography.
triggerTerms: western group photo with wide typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A group of five men in western wear (cowboy hats, denim, vests) arranged in a staggered depth composition across a desert floor under a bright, cloudy sky. The typography is positioned at the top, featuring a large, stylized serif title and a smaller, widely spaced subtitle.
coreVisualRelationships: Staggered depth between foreground and background subjects
Contrast between dark western clothing and bright sky
Horizontal alignment of typography across the upper third
Low-angle perspective emphasizing the subjects' stature
coreInvariants: Presence of cowboy hats on multiple subjects
Arid desert landscape with visible horizon line

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five subjects distributed across the frame; one seated in the foreground left, others standing at varying distances to create depth.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central standing figure in a dark jacket and white hat.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large top typography, moves down to the central figure, then scans left to right across the other band members.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper half of the frame is dominated by a bright, textured sky providing space for text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in the sky creates a silhouette effect for the dark-clothed subjects.

letterConstructionRules: Stencil-like gaps or thin hairlines in vertical strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Large black uppercase display serif paired with small copper lowercase serif, both utilizing extreme tracking.

candidateDirections.reason: High contrast and sharp serifs match the display style.
For the subtitle's wide-set feel, though lowercase is required.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a wide-angle photograph of five men in cowboy hats and western attire standing in a desert landscape with a bright, cloudy sky. Arrange them with one seated in the foreground and others standing at different depths.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a large, black, high-contrast serif font with very wide tracking at the top. Below it, add a subtitle in small, copper-colored lowercase serif letters with extreme tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the tracking on both text lines significantly wide?
Are the subjects wearing cowboy hats?
Is the background a desert with a prominent sky?
Is the main title in uppercase and the subtitle in lowercase?

mustRedesign: Identifiable facial features of the original subjects

mustAchieve: Legible text against a busy sky

postGenerationChecks: Check that the horizon line is in the lower third of the image.
Ensure the text does not obscure the subjects' faces.
Verify the copper color of the subtitle is distinct from the sky.
Confirm the stencil-like gaps in the main title are present.
recipe.reuseFormula: Group portrait + Desert landscape + Wide-tracked high-contrast serif typography
